project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions and heritage properties do not inflate the settlement score. features.fullDescription: 18th century, altered and pyramidal roof of kiln rebuilt 1912. L-plan rubble with slated roof, piended at kiln end and straight skewed at the other. Of wheel (10'6" dia 2'6" wide) only axle survives. 2 pairs of stones.
